payload.body: dc: usage-rules.md has landed as approved, at f57b6f2, its own commit with only its own path (people-leak clean, prettier clean). The CHANGELOG's Fixed line now reads 'pplr tags and pplr contact with no command name themselves in their usage, not tags.py and contact.py' (decision 14), re-banked on dc/wp13-docs at e7d0213. The README is next. It is the largest of the four: its opening (a checkout install, PPLR_ROOT, a bin/ tree), Requirements, Troubleshooting and Contributing are the legacy's, and it has smaller faults further down. Those are: the badge names test.yml where the workflow is tests.yml; applyicons is described as setpicfordir; doctor and setpicfordir have no section; the sync section says the sidecar is built into .build/ on first use and the workbook runs under uv; the backup default is ~/Library; the file-format examples carry a verblock() syntax the template does not use; and the tags examples cite a 'BCG DV' evidence line that may have come from real data. I'll replace those examples with the synthetic fixture's vocabulary.
